subject: Ciências
description_pt: Identificar características sobre o modo de vida (o que comem, como se reproduzem, como se deslocam etc.) dos animais mais comuns no ambiente próximo.

components.description_pt: Identificar os hábitos alimentares de animais comumente encontrados no ambiente local
components.description_en: Identify the feeding habits of animals commonly found in the local environment
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between animals that eat plants and animals that eat other animals as food sources

components.description_pt: Comparar modos de vida entre diferentes animais mais frequentemente observados no ambiente local
components.description_en: Compare ways of life among different animals most frequently observed in the local environment
components.cc_component_description: Compare survival advantages of group-living animals to those of solitary animals

cc_matches.description: All animals need food in order to live and grow. They obtain their food from plants or from other animals. Plants need water and light to live and grow.
Construct an argument that some animals form groups that help members survive.
